others.resetFactoryDesc: Zongisa application na état na yango ya ebandeli, effacer ba modèles nionso na histoire ya chat. Action oyo ezali irreversible mpe recommandé kaka soki application ebebi.

shortcuts.switchAssistantDesc: Cycle na assistant oyo alandi na chat.

interface.title: Interface ya kosala
interface.themeDesc: Bokokanisa motó ya likambo ya OS.
interface.fontSizeDesc: Bongisa bonene ya makomi ya app.
interface.notificationPositionDesc: Esika ba notifications ya toast ebimaka. Na Windows, default ezali na se-droite donc ba popups e couvrir ba contrôles ya fenêtre te.
interface.notificationPositionBottomRight: Na nse na lobɔkɔ ya mobali
interface.notificationPositionBottomLeft: Na nse na lobɔkɔ ya mwasi
interface.showTokenSpeedDesc: Lakisa ba jetons/sec mpe motango ya ba jetons na molongo na se ya ba messages ya mosungi. Ntango ekangami, elembo moko ya moke elakisaka makambo mikemike ntango ozali kobɛta.
interface.coloredUserBubble: Bulle ya message ya usager ya couleur
interface.coloredUserBubbleDesc: Salelá langi ya accent lokola fond ya ba messages na yo. Ntango bazali kokangama, bakokanisaka bansango ya mosungi na makomi ya pɛtɛɛ na fond neutre.
interface.renderHtmlArtifacts: Kosala HTML & biloko ya kala ya SVG
interface.renderHtmlArtifactsDesc: Bakisa onglet Aperçu na HTML mpe ba blocs ya code SVG. HTML ezo tambuisa lokasa oyo esalemi na modèle na cadre sandbox oyo ezo exécuter ba scripts na yango moko mais ekoki ko accéder Novera, ba fichiers na yo, to na réseau te; SVG ezo rendre statiquement na ba scripts désactivés. Off na ndenge ya libela.
interface.autoGenerateTitleDesc: Bosala résumé automatiquement masolo ya sika na titre ya thread. Boma mpo na kobatela titre par défaut tii tango yo moko oko changer kombo na yango.
interface.windowBackgroundDesc: Set couleur ya fond ya fenêtre ya app.
interface.appMainViewDesc: Botia langi ya sima ya esika ya makambo ya ntina.
interface.primaryDesc: Set couleur primaire pona ba accents ya interface.
interface.accentDesc: Pona langi ya accent oyo esalelami na kati ya UI mobimba.
interface.destructiveDesc: Botia langi ya ko souligner mpo na misala ya kobebisa.
interface.resetToDefaultDesc: Réinitialiser ba paramètres nionso ya interface na défaut.
interface.resetInterfaceSuccessDesc: Ba paramètres nionso ya interface ezongisami na ndenge ya liboso.
interface.threadScrollDesc: Pona ndenge nini port ya vue ya chat esengeli kosala tango ba messages ya sika ekomi.
interface.threadScrollFlowHint: Ebatelaka esika ya kotala oyo ekangami na nsango ya sika oyo otindi.
interface.threadScrollStickyHint: Automatiquement elandi lokola ba réponses ezo flux en temps réel.
interface.tokenCounterCompactDesc: Lakisa compteur ya jeton na kati ya entrée ya chat. Ntango ekangami, motángi ya bilembo ekobima na nse ya entrée.
interface.codeBlockDesc: Pona lolenge ya ko souligner syntaxe.
interface.showLineNumbersDesc: Lakisa ba numéros ya ligne na ba blocs ya code.
interface.resetCodeBlockStyle: Réinitialiser Style ya Bloc ya Code
interface.resetCodeBlockStyleDesc: Réinitialiser style ya bloc ya code na default.
interface.resetCodeBlockSuccess: Réinitialisation ya style ya bloc ya code na succès
interface.resetCodeBlockSuccessDesc: Style ya bloc ya code ezongi na défaut.
interface.subtitle: Sala Novera ya yo moko, kobanda na ndenge na yango ya komonana tii na ba préférences na yo ya masolo.
interface.accentColorDesc: Pona langi ya accent mpe ya barre ya mopanzi.

hardware.name: Kombo
hardware.enableVulkanDesc: Salelá Vulkan API mpo na GPU accélération. Kofungola Vulkan te soki ozali na NVIDIA GPU mpo ekoki kobimisa mikakatano ya boyokani.
hardware.noGpus: Ba GPUs moko te e détecté
hardware.backendApi: Backend API Ezali ndenge moko na .
hardware.deviceListError: Ekokaki kotanga GPU ba appareils te
hardware.noDevicesDesc: Ba GPU moko te emonanaka na moteur llama.cpp. Ba modèles ekotambola na CPU.
hardware.gpuDisabled: Bazali na makoki ya kosala mosala
hardware.backendApiDesc: Ndenge nini llama.cpp asololaka na oyo GPU .
hardware.backendSelectDesc: Salelá API oyo mpo na GPU oyo .
hardware.unifiedMemoryDesc: GPU ekabolaka pool moko ya mémoire na CPU — ba modèles ezuaka na mémoire moko na système mobimba.
hardware.engineRestartedForDevices: Ba GPU na yo ebongwanaki, yango wana moteur local ebandaki lisusu. Ba modèles ezo recharger na usage ya sima.
hardware.engineBusyDevicesChanged: Ba GPU na yo ebongwanaki, kasi modèle moko ezali occupé. Tika yango, sima finá Refresh mpo na kosalela GPU ya sika.

httpsProxy.proxyUrlDesc: URL na port ya serveur proxy na yo.
httpsProxy.authenticationDesc: Ba credentiels mpo na serveur proxy, soki esengeli.
httpsProxy.noProxyDesc: Liste ya ba hôtes oyo ekabwani na virgule mpo na koleka proxy.
httpsProxy.ignoreSslDesc: Tika ba certificats oyo ba signer yo moko to oyo e vérifié te. Yango ekoki kosenga mpo na ba proxy mosusu kasi ekitisaka bokengi. Activer kaka soki ozali na confiance na proxy na yo.
httpsProxy.proxySslDesc: Valider certificat SSL tango ozali ko connecter na proxy.
httpsProxy.proxyHostSslDesc: Bondimi certificat SSL ya hôte ya proxy.
httpsProxy.peerSslDesc: Bondimi ba certificats SSL ya ba connexions ya baninga.
httpsProxy.hostSslDesc: Bondimi ba certificats SSL ya ba hôtes ya destination.

webSearch.title: Bolukiluki na Internet
webSearch.description: Tika ba modèles baluka pe batanga web na kosalelaka ba outils intégrés ya Novera.
webSearch.enableDesc: Bosala piblisite ya bisaleli web_search mpe web_fetch na ba modèles oyo esungaka bosaleli bisaleli. Esalaka libanda ya boîte na clé API te.
webSearch.providerDesc: Pona backend oyo ekoyanola web_search na web_fetch.
webSearch.apiKeyOptional: Na bolingi na yo. Pesa fungola {{provider}} API mpo na ndelo ya taux ya likolo mpe mbano oyo ebongisami. Tika mpamba mpo na kosalela esika ya nsuka ya ofele oyo ezangi fungola.
webSearch.apiKeyRequired: Esengeli. {{provider}} esengeli na fungola API mpo na kozongisa ba résultats.
webSearch.endpointDesc: Esengeli. Base URL ya instance na yo {{provider}}, na JSON API oyo efungolami.

cowork.title: Cowork
cowork.description: Configurer surface ya agent Cowork : coquille na yango sandbox, bakisa ba souvenirs na ba compétences oyo ebombami libela na dossier ya ba données Novera na yo.
cowork.shellSandboxed: Ba commandes ezo tambola confinés na {{backend}}: ekoki kokoma kaka na kati ya esika ya mosala ya session, pe ba fichiers na dossier ya ndaku na yo ezali kotangama te.
cowork.shellUnavailable: Sandbox moko te ezali na système oyo, yango wana esaleli ya coquille epesami te. Ba commandes esalemaka jamais sans confinement.
cowork.networkDesc: Tika ba commandes Cowork ekoma na réseau, pona makambo lokola ko installer ba paquets to kozua ebombelo. On par défaut. Shell ya chat principal ezalaka jamais na accès na réseau.
cowork.noMemories: Ba souvenirs nanu te. Ba modèles babakisi bango na esaleli memory_write tango bazali koyekola makambo oyo ebongi kobomba.
cowork.noSkills: Makoki naino te. Compétence ezali ensemble ya ba instructions oyo ekoki kosalelama lisusu modèle ekoki ko charger na demande.
cowork.editMemoryDesc: Sujet moko na note moko. Ba modèles batangaka oyo sima na esaleli memory_read.
cowork.editSkillDesc: Markdown malako, na bolingi na ndimbola na YAML frontmatter. Description ezali oyo ba modèles ba monaka avant ya ko charger compétence.
cowork.loadFailed: Ekoki te ko charger esika ya mosala ya agent

localApiServer.title: API Serveur ya esika
localApiServer.description: Tambwisa serveur oyo ekokani na OpenAI na esika ofandi.
localApiServer.serverLogsDesc: Tala ba journal ya détail ya serveur API ya esika.
localApiServer.swaggerDocsDesc: Tala mikanda ya API ya interactif (Swagger UI).
localApiServer.runOnStartupDesc: Bandá automatiquement Serveur Local API tango application ekobanda.
localApiServer.runInBackgroundDesc: Bomba serveur esala na plateau ya système tango fenêtre ekangami. Tango ekangami, kokanga fenêtre elongwaka Novera mpe etelemisa serveur.
localApiServer.serverHostDesc: Addresse ya réseau mpo na serveur.
localApiServer.serverPortDesc: Nimero ya port mpo na serveur API.
localApiServer.apiPrefixDesc: Liboso ya nzela mpo na API bisika ya suka.
localApiServer.trustedHostsDesc: Ba hôtes bapesaki nzela ya kokɔta na serveur, ekabwani na virgule.
localApiServer.corsDesc: Tika ba demandes ya croix-origine na serveur API.
localApiServer.verboseLogs: Ba Logs ya Serveur ya Verbose
localApiServer.verboseLogsDesc: Activer ba journals ya serveur ya détails pona débogage.
localApiServer.proxyTimeoutDesc: Tango ya kozela eyano ya modèle local, secondes.
localApiServer.defaultModel: Modèle par défaut Local API Serveur
localApiServer.defaultModelDesc: Modèle local pona ko charger automatiquement tango serveur ekobanda.
localApiServer.defaultModelPlaceholder: Pona modèle moko ya esika ofandi

privacy.helpUsImproveDesc: Mpo na kosalisa biso tóbongisa Novera, okoki kokabola ba données anonymes lokola bosaleli ya makambo mpe motango ya basaleli. Tozwaka ata mokolo moko te ba chats to ba informations personnelles na yo.
privacy.privacyPolicy: Ozali na contrôle mobimba ya ba données na yo. Yekola makambo mingi na Mibeko na biso ya kobatela makambo ya moto ye moko.
privacy.analyticsDesc: Mpo na kobongisa Novera, tosengeli kososola lolenge nini esalelamaka —kasi kaka na lisalisi na yo. Okoki kobongola paramètre oyo ntango nyonso.
privacy.privacyPromises: Pona na yo awa ekobongola te bilaka na biso ya ntina ya kobatela makambo ya moto ye moko:
privacy.promise1: Masolo na yo etikalaka kaka yo moko mpe na aparɛyi na yo
privacy.promise2: Tozwaka ata mokolo moko te makambo na yo ya moto ye moko to makambo na yo ya kosolola na bato
privacy.promise3: Bokabolami ya ba données nionso ezali anonyme mpe esangisi
privacy.promise4: Okoki ko opter out tango nionso sans ko perdre fonctionnalité
privacy.promise5: Tozali transparent na oyo tosangisaka mpe mpo na nini

attachments.subtitle: Bongisa ba pièces jointes ya mikanda, ba limite ya taille, pe comportement ya récupération.
attachments.enableDesc: Tika ko uploader pe ko indexer mikanda pona kozua yango.
attachments.parseModeDesc: Pona ndenge nini mikanda oyo epanzani ebakisami na masolo.
attachments.parseModeInline: Kokɔtisa yango na kati ya kosolola
attachments.autoInlineThresholdDesc: Fraction ya contexte ya modèle oyo esalelami lokola cutoff pona ko inliner ba fichiers parsés na ba modèles locales.
attachments.maxFileDisabledReason: Bofungola Enable Attachments mpo na kobongola ndelo ya bonene ya mokanda.
attachments.maxFileDesc: Taille maximale na mokanda moko. Esalemi na tango ya upload mpe ya traitement. Bililingi ezali na ndelo na yango moko likoló.
attachments.maxImage: Bonene ya elilingi oyo eleki monene (MB)
attachments.maxImageDesc: Taille maximale na image moko (JPEG to PNG). Mopesi to modèle na yo akoki kosala ete ndelo ya nse ezala.
attachments.topKDesc: Maximum ya ba citations mpo na kozonga.
attachments.thresholdDesc: Point ya bokokani ya moke (0-1). Esalelamaka kaka mpo na boluki ya cosene linéaire, ANN te.
attachments.searchModeDesc: Pona kati na sqlite-vec ANN, cosine linéaire, to auto.
attachments.chunkSizeDesc: Ba caractères max approximatives par chunk pona ba embeddings.
attachments.chunkOverlapDesc: Bozindo ya bizaleli kati na biteni oyo elandi.
